{"command":"attempts=0
while [ $attempts -lt 14 ]; do
  attempts=$((attempts+1))
  echo "--- attempt $attempts ---"
  python3 -c 'import sys; print(1); sys.exit(1)'
  rc=$?
  echo "exit code: $rc"
  if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "SUCCESS: exited 0 on attempt $attempts"
    break
  fi
done
echo "total attempts run: $attempts""}
